ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low ratio; ventral surface is predominantly low-intensity pixels (black/dark grey) with sparse high-intensity (white) markings localized primarily at the margins.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-contrast white contiguous blobs are located at the extreme lateral tips of both lobes; a distinct white oval patch is visible on the inner-right lobe adjacent to the notch; multiple high-contrast linear streaks radiate from the lateral margins toward the fluke center.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped central depression with a calculated internal angle of approximately 45 degrees; the notch depth occupies roughly 12% of the total vertical lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations across the entire trailing edge; pixel-amplitude of variations ranges from 5 to 30 pixels; highest peak-to-valley density is observed on the medial sections of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: General convex curvature extending from the median notch to the lateral tips, with significant local deviations caused by the high-amplitude edge serrations.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Spatial detection of several circular high-contrast pixel clusters: one prominent white circle on the mid-left lobe, one white oval on the upper-right lobe, and multiple smaller clusters along the distal margins.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Extensive detection of unaligned, high-contrast linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) concentrated heavily on the lateral 25% of both fluke lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Pronounced irregular, calcified-appearing protrusion on the far-left lateral tip; smaller irregular structural deformity on the far-right lateral tip.
other_distinctive_markers: Intricate, high-contrast white scroll-like pigmentation pattern on the far-left margin, exhibiting a complex lace-like texture distinct from standard linear abrasions.
